verdict.rationale: Fireflies' security page says Enterprise customers get Private Storage to keep meeting data at their preferred location, on dedicated cloud storage, so it does offer a storage-location choice. That choice is limited to the Enterprise tier and is described only in marketing copy. missing for 10: availability below the Enterprise tier, a documented list of selectable regions or residency options, setup or configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Private Storage on Enterprise to store your meeting data at your preferred location.
Secure, dedicated cloud storage exclusively for your organization’s data.
